# Update verifier test fixtures

Generated by `python tests/fixtures/update/generate.py`.

Architecture matches the Phase 1 production publisher: single signer,
``signers=1, quorum=1, kt=1, nt=1``, 3 witnesses with ``toad=3``.
Multisig is out of scope for Phase 4 (see plan deviation #1).

## Layout

```
tests/fixtures/update/
├── generate.py
├── README.md
├── publisher_aid.json          # AID prefix + KEL state at fixture time
├── kel/
│   └── publisher.cesr          # full KEL stream: 3 witness icps + publisher icp + 3 release ixn
├── anchor/
│   ├── 1.0.0.cesr              # release anchor event for 1.0.0 (one event, with wigs)
│   ├── 1.0.1.cesr
│   └── 1.1.0.cesr
├── artifacts/
│   ├── Locksmith-1.0.0.dmg.stub
│   ├── Locksmith-1.0.0.msi.stub
│   ├── ...
├── appcast/
│   ├── macos.json
│   └── windows.json
└── tampered/
    ├── tampered_binary_1.0.1.dmg.stub
    ├── tampered_event_1.0.1.cesr
    ├── insufficient_receipts_1.0.1.cesr
    ├── stale_appcast_macos.json
    ├── downgrade_appcast_macos.json
    └── bad_rotation.cesr
```

Regenerate:

```bash
python tests/fixtures/update/generate.py
```

Tests must be insensitive to absolute paths (every fixture is referenced
relative to this directory).

Determinism: the generator uses deterministic salts. Public keys / SAIDs
are stable across runs **on the same keripy version**. Re-pin fixtures
after a keripy upgrade.
